provenance: Read from the Hugging Face model API for airkingbd/dplm_150m and airkingbd/dplm_650m (recorded under build-inputs/research/*-blobs.json in the build workspace). The commit ids are the API 'sha'. pytorch_model.bin digests are the LFS sha256 the API reports; config.json digests are the sha256 of the pinned bytes; every git_blob_sha1 is the API 'blobId'. Both variants list the SAME vocab.txt blob id (6b946952cc35537226f07fd70957ee2f848880d2), which is how 'same vocabulary bytes' is established.
vocab_sha256_note: vocab.txt is pinned by its git blob id, its 93-byte size and its sha256 (recomputed independently from the actual 93 bytes); the loader additionally requires the parsed token list to equal dplm_policy.DPLM_VOCAB entry for entry. A mismatch fails closed.
upstream: ByteDance DPLM (Apache-2.0): byprot/models/dplm/dplm.py, modules/dplm_modeling_esm.py, models/utils.py. Rotary theta 10000 is the original ESM value and the transformers EsmConfig default; it is not written in the pinned config.json.
